helper_bat:
@echo off
echo [%DATE% %TIME%] update start > "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log"
set /a COUNT=0
:retry
set /a COUNT+=1
echo [%DATE% %TIME%] attempt %COUNT% >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log"
if %COUNT% gtr 30 goto fail
ping 127.0.0.1 -n 2 > nul
copy /Y "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe" "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe.old" >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log" 2>&1
move /Y "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.new.exe" "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe" >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log" 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 goto retry
echo [%DATE% %TIME%] move success >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log"
if exist "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\data\.startup_ok" del "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\data\.startup_ok" >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log" 2>&1
ping 127.0.0.1 -n 2 > nul
set "_PYI_ARCHIVE_FILE="
set "_PYI_APPLICATION_HOME_DIR="
set "_PYI_PARENT_PROCESS_LEVEL="
set "_MEIPASS2="
set "PYINSTALLER_RESET_ENVIRONMENT=1"
start "" /D "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker" "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe"
echo [%DATE% %TIME%] new exe started >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log"
set /a WAIT=0
:waitok
set /a WAIT+=1
if %WAIT% gtr 120 goto rollback
ping 127.0.0.1 -n 2 > nul
if exist "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\data\.startup_ok" goto success
goto waitok
:success
echo [%DATE% %TIME%] startup OK after %WAIT%s >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log"
if exist "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe.old" del "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe.old" >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log" 2>&1
del "%~f0"
exit /b 0
:rollback
echo [%DATE% %TIME%] ROLLBACK: startup_ok not found in 120s >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log"
taskkill /F /IM "swim-worker-gui.exe" >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log" 2>&1
ping 127.0.0.1 -n 3 > nul
move /Y "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe.old" "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe" >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log" 2>&1
mkdir "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\data" 2>nul
echo {"rolled_back_from":"v1.3.1"} > "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\data\.update_rollback.json"
start "" /D "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker" "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe"
del "%~f0"
exit /b 0
:fail
echo [%DATE% %TIME%] FAILED after %COUNT% attempts, restarting current exe >> "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-update.log"
mkdir "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\data" 2>nul
echo {"rolled_back_from":"v1.3.1","reason":"move_failed"} > "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\data\.update_rollback.json"
start "" /D "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker" "C:\Users\tanaka\swim-worker\swim-worker-gui.exe"
del "%~f0"
exit /b 1
